missions.flavor: Show no mercy. Exterminate your enemies.

entries.text: For each enemy unit destroyed this turn.

missions.flavor: The enemy holds your assigned objectives. Commit your forces in full and sweep them from these locations post-haste.

entries.text: For each enemy unit that started the turn within range of one or more objectives and is destroyed.

missions.flavor: Unguarded prizes lie strewn across the field of battle. Secure them and deny them to the enemy.
missions.intro: If the Cleanse Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

entries.text: A terrain area was plundered this turn.

rows.label: UNITS
rows.text: One unit within a terrain area that is not within your territory.

missions.flavor: Intimidation is a potent weapon. Demonstrate your battlefield supremacy with a brutal show of force and erode what remains of the enemy's morale.

entries.text: There are more friendly units than enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within No Man’s Land.
There are more friendly units than enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within No Man’s Land.

missions.flavor: Exploit the flanks; use your speed and momentum to surround the foe and catch them in the jaws of a trap.

entries.text: One or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 6" of one or more battlefield edges and not within your territory.
Two or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 6" of opposite battlefield edges and one or more of those units is not within your territory.

missions.flavor: Bold and defiant, your chosen champions taunt the foe, drawing them on. Should they hold fast in the face of the inevitable response, the enemy’s momentum will surely falter.
missions.intro: Select one friendly unit on the battlefield or embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield to be your beacon unit.

scoring.when: End of your opponent’s turn or the end of the fifth battle round (whichever comes first).

entries.text: Your beacon unit is on the battlefield and not within your deployment zone.
Your beacon unit is on the battlefield and not within your territory.

missions.flavor: Your forces have identified a series of tainted objectives in this area. Purify these locations.
missions.intro: If the Plunder Secondary Mission is active for you, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

entries.text: One objective was cleansed by your army this turn.
Two or more objectives were cleansed by your army this turn.

rows.label: UNITS
rows.text: One friendly unit within range of one objective (excluding your home objective).

rows.label: USE LIMIT
rows.text: Unlimited. Each unit that starts this action this phase must be within range of a different objective.

rows.label: COMPLETES
rows.text: End of your turn, if that unit is controlling that objective.

rows.label: EFFECT
rows.text: That objective is cleansed by your army.

missions.flavor: Target and eliminate the most numerous and potent of enemy infantry to shatter their battle line.
missions.intro: If there are no enemy units with a starting strength of 13+ on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

entries.text: For each enemy unit with a starting strength of 13+ destroyed this turn.

missions.flavor: You are charged with the defence of a critical objective. It must not be permitted to fall into enemy hands.
missions.intro: If it is the first battle round, draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

scoring.when: End of your opponent’s turn or the end of the fifth battle round (whichever comes first).

entries.text: You control your home objective.
No enemy units are within your deployment zone.

missions.flavor: Probe their lines and engage any resistance. Stretch the foe to breaking point.
missions.intro: If one or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are wholly within a table quarter, and those units are not within 6" of the centre of the battlefield, you have a presence in that table quarter.

entries.text: You have a presence in three table quarters.
You have a presence in four table quarters.

missions.flavor: You must advance swiftly into no man’s land and seize it before the enemy can, lest they take control of the battlefield.

entries.text: You control two or more objectives within No Man’s Land (excluding your home objective).

missions.flavor: You must break the enemy line and establish a forward position to launch fresh assaults.
missions.intro: If it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

entries.text: You control your opponent’s home objective and/or each expansion objective.

missions.flavor: The heart of the battlefield is key to victory. Dominate the centre ground, and you shall be one step closer to achieving your goals.

entries.text: One or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield, and no enemy units are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield.
One or more friendly units (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) are within 3" of the centre of the battlefield, and no enemy units are within 6" of the centre of the battlefield.

missions.flavor: The enemy looks to their champions for courage. Identify and eliminate them with extreme prejudice.

entries.text: For each enemy CHARACTER model destroyed this turn.
For each of those models with a W of 4 or more.
One or more enemy CHARACTER models were destroyed this turn, or all enemy CHARACTER models have been destroyed during the battle.

missions.flavor: An opportunity to seize a valuable asset has been identified, but the enemy are likely to use it as bait in a trap. Move to secure the site, but be wary of enemy ambushes.
missions.intro: Your opponent selects one objective (excluding home objectives) within No Man’s Land to be your tempting target.

entries.text: You control your tempting target.

missions.flavor: Your orders are clear: break through the enemy and cut off their escape routes.
missions.intro: If it is the first battle round, you can draw one new Secondary Mission card and shuffle this card back into your Secondary Mission deck.

entries.text: For each friendly unit (excluding AIRCRAFT and battle-shocked units) wholly within your opponent’s deployment zone.

missions.flavor: Prioritise the destruction of heavily armoured assets. Bring them down at all costs.
missions.intro: If there are no enemy models with a W of 10 or more on the battlefield, you can discard this card and draw one new Secondary Mission card.

entries.text: For each enemy model with a W of 10 or more destroyed this turn.

missions.flavor: The strategic prizes in this region must be guarded at all costs – a duty that falls upon a chosen few.
missions.intro: WHEN DRAWN/START OF YOUR TURN: For each objective, you can select one friendly unit on the battlefield to guard that objective. Until the start of your next turn, while that unit is within range of that objective and while you control that objective, that objective is guarded by your army.

scoring.when: End of your opponent’s turn or the end of the fifth battle round (whichever comes first).

entries.text: For each objective guarded by your army.
